title: Kerala State Health Insurance Scheme – legacy CHIS Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Former Kerala Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme that provided health insurance to eligible poor and other households before convergence into KASP.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Historical eligibility based on Kerala's CHIS rules; use as legacy retrieval context rather than a current enrolment decision.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Kerala State Health Insurance Scheme – legacy CHIS.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
